svg.desc: A code window in pink chrome with glitter at its edges. It reads: name Chanelle Bingham; role self-taught developer; based in Australia; studying at the University of Tasmania; on GitHub since July 2026; building everember.ai, private AI companions; focus accessibility and docs; merged into Hugo, Mozilla, Home Assistant, JupyterLab, MUI X, Quarto, sphinx-autoapi and Western Friend; vibe Barbie Y2K.
